document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

chart.alt: Two maps of a city park, 2005 (top) and 2025 (bottom); north is at the top. Two paths cross in the middle, one running north to south and one west to east. 2005: tennis courts in the north-west, a lake in the north-east, a car park in the south-west, a café and a playground in the south-east, and one gate in the south. 2025: the tennis courts have become a skate park; the lake is unchanged, with a new boat hire point on its southern shore; a second gate has been opened on the eastern side at the end of the west–east path; the car park has become a community garden; bike parking has been added next to the south gate; the café has been extended with a terrace; the playground is unchanged.
